verification_report.summary: The proof correctly reduces arbitrary compactly supported smooth test functions to compactly supported moment-chart pieces, uses the calibrated product moment graph to retain dependence beyond the radial coordinate, and computes the distributional Laplacian by weighted edgewise integration by parts. The retraction and skeleton statements justify the slope audit: all contracted directions have slope zero, while the two primitive unit-weight directions at the Gauss point each contribute one, giving mass two. Boundary terms vanish or cancel by calibration and compact support. The cited Chambert-Loir–Ducros integration, Stokes, analytic tropical-space, and partition-of-unity results match their authoritative statements and apply in the stated setting.
